Q1_zero_volume_bars_before_first_trade.summary: Official docs do not verbatim-state the first-session boundary; official semantics (E1/E2/E3/E4) imply the series starts at the first available bar and emits no bars before it. Observed corpus (cu2504 night from 21:11 vol=1, zero-volume bars only after) is consistent.

Q2_returned_start_later_than_requested_s.summary: Direct consequence of E2 + E4 + E1: no-trade periods produce no bars, data starts from listing, and the API returns only stored bars in the range; a newly listed contract with a late first trade has returned_start later than requested_start.

Q3_bar_every_minute_guarantee.summary: E2 (skip on no trade), E3 (non-continuous K-lines), E5 (missing time slots) together show TqSdk does not guarantee a bar per minute.

Q4_range_vs_availability_semantics.summary: start_dt/end_dt define a filter window; the API returns the provider's stored bars inside it; full population is not guaranteed.

Q5_no_bars_before_listing_first_trade.summary: E1 ('从上市开始' - from listing) plus E2/E3: historical series has no bars before listing/first trade.

official_evidence_base.statement: TqSdk provides all tick/K-line data '从上市开始' (from listing) for all currently tradable contracts.
Non-trading periods produce no K-line bars (e.g. cu1805 13:00-13:30 not trading -> its K-line data in that period is skipped).
When a contract has no data at a time, that bar is skipped and K-lines can be non-continuous.
get_kline_data_series returns only the bars the server stores within [start_dt, end_dt); download pages by K-line id without synthesizing missing minutes.
Official example explicitly handles days whose trading-time slots are not fully filled (bars can be missing for parts of a period).

original_phrase_refinement.rationale: Official TqSdk semantics (E1/E2/E3/E4) say no-trade/no-listing periods have no bars and the series starts at the first available bar; leading missing minutes are absent by design, not lost or randomly truncated.

rejected_candidates.PROVIDER_DATA_INCOMPLETE: implies data loss the official semantics do not support
rejected_candidates.UNRESOLVED_PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY_SEMANTI: used only as a residual note for the exact first-session leading-edge rule

original_verdict_impact.detail: MIXED_ROOT_CAUSES stands; primary component re-characterized as NO_BAR_BEFORE_FIRST_AVAILABLE_TRADE; secondary listing-boundary authority/planner findings are reinforced.

recommended_repair: UNCHANGED - re-request reproduces leading-absent bars; re-scope first-day expected coverage or use another authoritative source for genuinely-traded leading minutes.
residual_gap: INSUFFICIENT_OFFICIAL_EVIDENCE for the verbatim mechanism of the first-session leading edge only; overall semantic direction is unambiguous.
